paper_metadata.title: Zr addition-induced transitions of deformation mechanism at high temperatures of Nb-Si-Ti based multi-alloys: Super-dislocations in γ-Nb5Si3

evidence.quote: mechanisms of two different deformation and fracture modes at 1250 °C of directional solidified Nb-Si-Ti based multi-alloys are investigated
This work investigates the effect of Zr element on the microstructure and tensile deformation at 1250 /C176C of the directional solidified Nb-Si-Ti based multi-alloys

Then master alloy rods were cut from the ingot by electro-discharge machining (EDM).
The melt temperature was set at 1980 °C and the directional solidifications were designed at a drawing rate of 500 μm/s with a Ga-In-Sn coolant.
